$comment: Probe pass 6 (Stocktake Run unit 44): six new prompts, one per spec §6 target, none of passes 1–5. G4 counts these six. `generate-all.mjs <out> 3 "" tools/golden-prompts/probes-6.json`, then `record-generate-run.mjs <out> runs/probe-6 probe-6 tools/golden-prompts/probes-6.json` and `icon-metric.mjs runs/probe-6 --prompts tools/golden-prompts/probes-6.json`.

prompts.prompt: A New Kingdom Egyptian river town: mud-brick houses and workshops along the bank, a pylon temple with an avenue of sphinxes running down to the water, and reed boats drawn up on the Nile's mud.
watches: the temple as the centerpiece — dominance by mass on flat ground
a river town whose river must hold water (F26's note)

prompts.prompt: A silver mining camp high on a mountainside and the smelter town in the valley floor below it, joined by an aerial ore tramway — a line of timber pylons carrying buckets down the slope.
watches: two places at two heights, joined by one program that must meet both
a camp on a steep seat (the hillside/cliff seat)
the tramway's dominance is span and drop — a read-it

prompts.prompt: An ice-fishing town on a frozen lake in the taiga: huts out on the ice around their fishing holes, sleds and skis by the doors, and a timber church with a bell tower on the shore.
watches: a freezing climate now that water freezes (F32: snow always → ice)
huts on the ice — a seat on a frozen surface (F30's family; what the model does with it)
a snowy taiga palette, T9 on a modern-ish era

prompts.prompt: A glacier filling a U-shaped mountain valley: the ice tongue ending in a milky lake at its snout, lateral moraines along both walls, and a braided river running out across the gravel below — no settlement of any kind.
watches: terrain-only, the terrain kit, a fifth time
ice as a landform (a glacier is not frozen water — what the model reaches for)
a braided river on gravel: water that must hold

prompts.prompt: A Victorian seaside resort on a fair day: a long promenade with a bandstand, a paddle steamer moored at the end of the pleasure pier, and hot-air balloons rising over the beach.
watches: icons that live in a prop pack (paddle_steamer, gazebo, hot_air_balloon, pier) — reached for as props, and measured
a prop-carried centerpiece's dominance (a read-it, or 'unmeasured')
a promenade as a linear precinct on the shore

prompts.prompt: A village of stone-carvers laid out on a colossal chessboard of black and white marble squares, with giant chess pieces as its monuments: a king-piece tower at the centre and two knight-pieces guarding the road in.
watches: T8: a bespoke ground (the board) and bespoke monuments (the pieces) in one prompt
the king as the centerpiece — dominant by height
buildings seated on a bespoke paving — does the board survive the streets?
